title: This Used to Take 2 Years. Claude Science Does It in Days.
description:
Anthropic just shipped Claude Science and it is not a smarter science chatbot. It is a full research environment that brings every tool a scientist needs into one place.

━━━ WHAT IT IS ━━━
→ 60+ pre-configured tools for genomics, single-cell, proteomics, structural biology, cheminformatics
→ Connects to UniProt, PDB, ClinVar, ChEMBL, GEO, Ensembl, and more in plain language
→ Renders 3D protein structures, genome browser tracks, chemical structures natively
→ Every figure includes the exact code, environment, and message history that produced it

━━━ HOW IT WORKS ━━━
→ Runs on your own hardware: laptop, Linux box, or HPC login node via SSH
→ Scales to hundreds of GPUs via Modal when needed
→ Sensitive data never leaves your systems
→ A reviewer agent catches bad citations and untraceable numbers automatically

━━━ REAL RESULTS ━━━
→ Allen Institute neuroscientist: 10 reviews (100+ pages each), previously took 2 years to write one
→ UCSF Brain Tumor Center: genomic analysis time cut to one-tenth

━━━ HOW TO GET IT ━━━
→ Beta now on macOS and Linux for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise
→ claude.com/science
→ 50 AI for Science research projects, up to $30,000 in credits each. Apply by July 15.

Is this the moment AI starts changing the pace of scientific discovery? Let us know below.

#ClaudeScience #Anthropic #AIResearch #AINews #AI
